alterations.description: Deletion of specific lines from the song 'Chhup Chhup Sanam tujhe meri kasam'.
Shots of a dacoit advancing towards Gazala in a drunken condition with lascivious remarks.
Shot of the auctioneer taking liberties with Gazala while she is being sold.
Hassam's remark to Gulbano: 'Auo hamarc gale lag jao, hamari halat kharab ho gai hai.'
In the song-dance sequence 'O dil tham ke sun betab...', shot of jerking of hips by Gazala and the Kotwal's sensuous reaction.
In the song 'Kal tak to ek tho...', prominent views of Gulbano's emphasised bust and the line: 'Main bhi gol mol hun, banda bhi burik hain.'
Near-views of direct spear thrusts in fighting scenes.
In the song 'Aansuon ki arj aahon ki...', shot of a prisoner lying on nails with hands tied up.
Shots of bust-shaking by Nadira before the song 'Main Baghdad ki jadoogarni' starts.
From the dialogue of Zarina's father addressed to Daku, the sentence: 'Musalman talwar ke saaye men paida hota hai, aur talwar ke saye men marta hai.'
The close-up of the robber chief drawing the dagger from his stomach after being stabbed by Nadira.

producer: M . K . Films, Krishna Cinema Bldg., Tribhuvan Road , Bombay - 4 .

alterations.description: Dialogue between Johnny and Saku: 'Idhar bichmen.' and Johnny's lines: 'Aisa nikaluinga ki pata bhi nahin chalegi . . . . kanta to kab ka nikal gaya , dard baqi rah guya .'
The close-up of the gorilla and the silhouette of the tall ghost-like creature.
Near-views of skulls and reduction of weird noises in the den of the magi.
During the song-dance sequence 'Kablak bane rahenge, zulmon ka hum alsbapa...', near-views of Madhu with emphasised bust (all shots blown up).
In the dance sequence, car-front views of indecorous movements of girls in Arab costume.
Near-views of the distorted face and hands of the guru.
Shot of Madhu in a swimming costume lying on the ground after being rescued by Jaj, with part of her under-clothing visible.
In the song 'Do ek do, do duni chaar...', the lines: 'Dil ko dil se mila ke dekho,' and 'Aankh se aankh lara ke dekho.'
Johnny's remark: 'Hamne Love ka matric pass kiya hai.'
Johnny's remark referring to Saku: 'Kiya chalta hai. . . . . . isi liyon to hum marta hai.'
Visuals of a skull swinging in the magician's cave and of the distorted face and figure of the guru.
Details of gambling in the Casino, particularly of handling of currency notes and roulette table etc.

film_title: Hercules In The Centre of The Earth

alterations.description: Shots, before credit titles, of a girl with blood-stained neck, her screaming, and claws/heads of ghost-like creatures emerging from stone tombs.
Shots of Theseus lying over a girl and kissing her.
All close shots of the stone monster, Procrustes, when he tries to kill Theseus and his companion.
The shot of Lichog's frightening shadow as he suddenly appears in Delanira's room from the rear.
Shots of claws of ghost-like creatures emerging from stone tombs and a flash of the ghost-like creatures appearing repeatedly to attack Hercules.
Shots of a man being pierced through by mechanically operated spears.
Shots of Theseus falling in boiled lava.
Shots of Helena lying with bleeding neck along with her screaming.

After song 6, delete the shot of Madhavi abandoning the baby at the gate and the camera zooming to the infant.
Madhavi's dialogues indicating that she was not a married woman.
